name: Molten for Discord
description: Molten glass for Discord: a lava-lamp background made from the image, video, stream or profile you're looking at (or the server's icon), frosted glass over it, favorite channels on the lava button, glowing mentions, art-colored title bar and seek bar, Screenshot safe and privacy blur. Click the lava button in the top bar for settings.
intro: Molten for Discord puts a lava-lamp background made from what you're looking at behind frosted-glass panes, and keeps your favorite channels one point away on the lava button.

rows.title: Match the title bar to the art
rows.desc: Same picture, video or server the lava is showing

rows.title: Match the seek bar to the art
rows.desc: The played part and the ball on videos and audio

rows.title: Server tint
rows.desc: No media on screen? The lava takes the server's icon colors. Off = Discord purple

rows.title: Show favorites when you point at it
rows.desc: Off = the lava button only opens this panel

rows.title: Images and videos
rows.desc: Blurred until you point at them

features: Lava from what you're looking at
The background comes from the image, video or stream in the middle of the chat, or the profile you open. With nothing on screen it takes the server's icon colors, or Discord purple.
The server list, channels, chat and member list turn to frosted glass, with Calm, User and Crazy profiles that each keep their own look.
Point at the lava button and your favorite channels, threads and DMs drip down from it. Reorder them, color them by server and see Recent in the panel.
Messages that mention you get a lava glow instead of a flat bar, with lava blobs around them if you like.
The title bar and the video seek bar take their color from the lava. When nothing on screen gives a color, Prism takes the title bar back.
Hide your own name and avatar, and blur images, DMs, server icons or whole channels until you point at them.
The lava pauses while you scroll and when Discord isn't the active window, and calms down during calls and streams.
